name: gohighlevel-mcp-server
description: MCP server for curated GoHighLevel API v2 coverage.
long_description: Connect Claude to your [GoHighLevel](https://www.gohighlevel.com) CRM. 56 curated tools over the GoHighLevel API v2 covering contacts, custom fields (v1, V2, and folders), custom values, tags, opportunities, pipelines, conversations, calendars, appointments, locations, and users. Fills gaps the official HighLevel MCP leaves open: full custom-field CRUD, contact delete, and a guarded duplicate-contact merge. Destructive operations (deletes, merges, outbound message sends) require an explicit confirm flag on every call.
